articles.summary: TORONTO, Oct. 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Allied Gold Corporation (TSX: AAUC; NYSE: AAUC) (“Allied” or the “Company”) is pleased to provide an update on its Kurmuk Mine in Ethiopia as it advances toward production startup. The Kurmuk Mine is a cornerstone of Allied’s production and cash flow growth, delivering a significant increase in production at attractive operating costs while enhancing the scale, quality and longevity of the Company’s portfolio.
